Woman Writes Suicide Note in Mehndi on Limbs in Chhindwara

In Chhindwara, a married woman named Preeti died after consuming poison. Before her death, she wrote a suicide note using mehndi on her hands and feet. Police are considering this a significant piece of evidence, noting that the mehndi was used to ensure the note could not be easily erased.
